title: Common-stage evaluation descent assertion
statement: Fix finite-field data $D$, a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a $D.k$-scheme $W$. Define $\operatorname{SfQbarEvaluationDescent}(D,\ell,\Omega,W)$ as follows. For every permitted internal-Hom pair and every common finite coefficient stage representing its Hom, tensor and target objects, any representative $\varphi$ of the identity represents evaluation by tensor comparison followed by inverse finite-stage Hom transpose of $\varphi$ followed by the Hom comparison. Also require the naturality equation $T(Hg,1)\,ev_Q=T(1,g_1)\,ev_P\,g_2$ for every morphism of permitted pairs. The residue inverse is induced by $\ell\ne D.p$. No descent theorem is part of this definition. The constituent notions are [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces].
